title: FBI-UAP-D010, FD-302-71, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2026
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview record detailing multiple UAP sightings by a civilian witness, including a historical account from 1987.

incidents.summary: Witness observed two yellow balls of light, one basketball-sized and one beach ball-sized, moving laterally behind trees near their property.
incidents.quote: noticed a ball of light through windshield which was yellow and about the size of a basketball

incidents.summary: Witness observed several white orbs traveling from west to east at a high altitude.
incidents.quote: saw several white orbs travel over house from the west to the east

incidents.summary: Witness observed a red light circling itself near power lines, hovering, and landing near a power station.
incidents.quote: saw a red light circling around itself at night
